---
title: "How low can trimmed sink rate be driven with free geometry without cosmetics?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 480.0
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0
PROBE_POOL = 900.0
PROBE_SPENT = 10.9

sink_with_cosmetics = 0.84 # from 05-optimised-geometry/2026-09-29-01-how-low-can-trimmed-sink-rate-be-driven-with-free-geometry-and-ballast.qmd

res = optimize_geometry_for_sink_rate(get_airplane)
plane = get_airplane(res['wing_x_le'], res['le_sweep'], res['wing_inc'])
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{res['sink']:.2f}"`]{.hero-value}
[m/s minimum trimmed sink rate]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Removing the cosmetic components drops the minimum attainable sink rate from [`{python} sink_with_cosmetics`]{.key} m/s ([How low can trimmed sink rate be driven with free geometry and ballast?](../05-optimised-geometry/2026-09-29-01-how-low-can-trimmed-sink-rate-be-driven-with-free-geometry-and-ballast.qmd)) to [`{python} f"{res['sink']:.2f}"`]{.key} m/s. The optimal configuration uses an unswept wing and requires no nose ballast, trimming at a slow [`{python} f"{res['v_trim']:.2f}"`]{.key} m/s. 

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from IPython.display import display, Markdown

md = f"""
| Parameter | Optimised value |
|---|---|
| Wing position (LE) | `{res['wing_x_le']*100:.1f}` cm |
| Leading edge sweep | `{res['le_sweep']:.1f}`° |
| Wing incidence | `{res['wing_inc']:.1f}`° |
| Nose ballast | `{res['mass_ballast']*1000:.1f}` g |
| Trimmed speed | `{res['v_trim']:.2f}` m/s |
| Trim angle of attack | `{res['alpha_trim']:.1f}`° |
"""
display(Markdown(md))
```
